notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content:
With the first patch after launch, the game now features an improved icon arrangement on the table for better visibility. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37800825/0c2253fc7295f0da8d91d80d3ac14f3715655a3c.png


This patch also includes a bugfix which caused some GPU coolers to run wild (framerate now limited to 60FPS).
